findings.native_crash: Both sessions crash in mission main at ce.InitOffline(), immediately after loading the bicycle event layer.
findings.missing_registration: Actual cfgeconomycore.xml lacks MotorbikeScript; the next registered event layer enables seven native motorbike variants.
findings.bicycle_warnings: All eight bicycle event children are missing from the loaded CE type database. The Bicycle author switched to vanilla bike simulation in October.
findings.airdrop_schema: First run reports VPP_Map.MapColor static array JSON error. Publisher repaired it before second run.
findings.wrap_compile_fix: Both uploaded sessions compile and load the World and Mission modules; the prior Transport compile error is absent.
findings.root_cause_limit: Missing motorcycle CE registration is a concrete configuration defect at the startup stage that crashed. Native crash resolution needs a fresh game launch.

native_root_evidence.observed_crash_phase: Hive.InitOffline, during CE dynamic event loading after base32+bicycle1 events, before landlayer completion
native_root_evidence.crash_resolution: Native DayZ execution required; cause inferred from missing CE root and log phase
native_root_evidence.partial_existing_event_overrides: Supported by official documentation; left unchanged

airdrop_evidence.author_schema_section: 9. VPP_Map; c. MapColor; RGB integer array with values 0 to 255
airdrop_evidence.actual_observation: First-run backup has no VPP_Map; crash log reports VPP_Map.MapColor static array; current and second-run backup contain publisher-filled VPP_Map with MapColor [0,0,0].
